description: Implemented Codex intelligence suggestions for this workspace.

entries.summary: Codify A1/A2/B1 as permanent self-improve guardrails
entries.proposal_text: Add a repo validator for SKILL frontmatter and heredoc anti-patterns, block Bash Python heredocs on Windows, and keep the session scorer bound to the active launcher.
entries.context_for_other_clis: This came from the 2026-04-22 self-improve run after repeated loader blindness and missing session score telemetry.
entries.why_it_was_implemented: The three issues break discoverability, one-off command reliability, and longitudinal self-observation.
entries.how_it_was_implemented: Added validate-codex-setup.mjs, expanded the self-improve workflow to require it, patched bash-guard.ps1, patched session-scorer.ts for modern transcripts, and wired Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1 to run the scorer after Codex exits.
entries.resilience_summary: The fix uses defense in depth: static validation, runtime blocking, session-end scoring, and local skill deployment.
entries.future_failure_review: Without these guards, a long description can hide a skill again, Windows one-offs can fail silently, and trend analysis goes blind because session-scores.jsonl never appears.

entries.summary: Port Claude Code setup intelligence into Codex bridge tooling
entries.proposal_text: Give Codex the same setup-delta intelligence as Claude Code by adapting Claude's bridge registry and audit scripts into codex-setup.
entries.context_for_other_clis: The user asked to port the Claude Code setup folder into Codex terms so Codex gains the same intelligence instead of merely referencing Claude Code.
entries.why_it_was_implemented: The Codex setup had a whiteboard and self-improve base but could not actually inspect Claude setup deltas; without this, future Claude improvements would remain invisible or require manual copying.
entries.how_it_was_implemented: Added Codex bridge registry helper, Claude/Gemini delta bridge metadata, real audit scripts, bootstrap/report scripts, README documentation, validator checks, and ledger entries.
entries.resilience_summary: The port is additive, keeps Claude/Gemini read-only, classifies REPLACE separately, validates required bridge files, and exposes bootstrap-report output for future sessions.
entries.future_failure_review: If a future edit deletes bridge files, changes registry paths, or reintroduces Claude target paths, validate-codex-setup and audit smoke tests should fail before commit.
